a.lede: Two critical bugs in the PHP web programming language, used by the majority of the internet, threatened to upend the internet — and it's unlikely to be the last major software scare.
a.title: PHP-ocalypse: How two critical web bugs almost broke the internet

b.lede: Two critical vulnerabilities have been identified with PHP, a programming language which is widely used across the internet.
b.title: Websites taken down across Europe ahead of critical cyber-security update
